'''Mitch Knaub''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2001 Greeley tournament]] on 20 April 2001 with Rendili Star Destroyers, according to Jason Keen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2227">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-03-greely-co-4-20-01-a-new-secret-based2227/ greely-co-4-20-01-a-new-secret-base], DeckTech (Jason "Qui" Keen, 3 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-03-greely-co-4-20-01-a-new-secret-based2227/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
